items.exampleEn: The young playwright won a prize for her first play.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕劇作家以她的第一部劇作得獎。

items.exampleEn: The museum keeps its most famous masterpiece behind thick glass.
items.exampleZh: 博物館把館內最有名的傑作放在厚玻璃後面。

items.exampleEn: The piano player added three new pieces to her repertoire this year.
items.exampleZh: 那位鋼琴手今年在她的演奏曲目裡加了三首新曲子。
items.glossZh: （可表演的）全部曲目；拿手項目

items.exampleEn: The rhythmic sound of the rain helped me fall asleep.
items.exampleZh: 有節奏的雨聲讓我睡著了。

items.exampleEn: My favorite ballad is about two friends who never meet again.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的抒情歌是關於兩個再也沒見面的朋友。

items.exampleEn: Good poems do not always need rhyme.
The streets were full of music and colorful costumes during the carnival.
items.exampleZh: 嘉年華期間，街上滿是音樂和繽紛的服裝。

items.exampleEn: Carrying a cello on a crowded bus is not easy.
items.exampleZh: 在擁擠的公車上帶著大提琴可不容易。

items.sentenceEn: In English, the word cat rhymes with hat.
items.sentenceZh: 在英文裡，cat 和 hat 押韻。

items.audioEn: The carnival parade starts at noon, so let's get there early to find a good spot.
items.audioZh: 嘉年華遊行中午開始，我們早點去找個好位置吧。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼想早點去？

items.sentenceEn: Many people think this painting is the artist's greatest masterpiece.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人認為這幅畫是這位畫家最偉大的傑作。

items.sentenceEn: She has played the cello in the city orchestra for twenty years.
items.sentenceZh: 她在市立樂團拉大提琴二十年了。

items.stemEn: The ____ finished the script in just three weeks and also directed the show.
items.stemZh: 那位劇作家只花三週就寫完劇本，還親自執導這齣戲。

items.stemEn: The singer has a wide ____, from old folk songs to modern pop.
items.stemZh: 那位歌手的曲目很廣，從老民謠到現代流行歌都有。

items.passageEn: Every spring, our town holds a music and theater carnival. This year, a local playwright presented a new comedy about a cozy village bakery. Many people called it a masterpiece. In the main square, a street band played rhythmic dance music, and an old singer performed a ballad about the sea that made people cry. A young musician played the cello beautifully, and her repertoire ranged from classical pieces to film music. For the children, there was a poetry corner where they made up silly rhymes about animals. It was the most cheerful week of the year.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我們鎮上都會舉辦音樂戲劇嘉年華。今年，一位在地劇作家推出一齣新喜劇，講的是一間溫馨的鄉村麵包店，很多人稱它為傑作。在主廣場上，一個街頭樂團演奏節奏感十足的舞曲，一位老歌手唱了一首關於大海的抒情歌，讓人聽了落淚。一位年輕音樂家拉大提琴拉得很動聽，她的曲目從古典樂到電影配樂都有。給孩子的詩歌角落裡，孩子們編了好笑的動物押韻兒歌。那是一年中最歡樂的一週。

questions.questionZh: 在地劇作家的新喜劇講什麼？
孩子們在詩歌角落做什麼？
options: 編好笑的動物押韻兒歌

items.promptZh: 這首歌的節奏很強，讓人想跳舞。
referenceEn: This song is very rhythmic and makes people want to dance.
The song has a strong, rhythmic beat that makes you want to dance.
rubricZh: rhythmic 是形容詞（例如 very rhythmic、a rhythmic beat）
「讓人想跳舞」可寫，例如 makes people want to dance 等

items.promptZh: 他在婚禮上唱了一首抒情歌給新娘聽。
referenceEn: He sang a ballad for the bride at the wedding.
At the wedding, he sang the bride a ballad.
rubricZh: ballad 指「抒情歌」（例如 a ballad 等）
「唱給…聽」可寫，例如 sang a ballad for、sang … a ballad、sang a ballad to 等
時態用過去式或現在完成式（例如 sang 等）
